svg.title: Why LibreOffice pagination can diverge from Word print
svg.desc: A long run of digits plus full-width punctuation is treated by Word or WPS as a sequence that may break character by character. LibreOffice treats the same run as one unbreakable western word and pushes it to the next line, shifting later lines and spilling content onto the next page.
